name: io.aicoachellavalley/local-decisions
title: AICV Local Decisions
description: Read-only Coachella Valley business-preview discovery and sourced local decision support. Returns source dates, fit and constraints where documented, and official action links where sourced. Does not book, charge, check live inventory or guarantee assistant recommendations. Research retrieval remains available from the separate regional research MCP.

tools.name: resolve_local_intent
tools.description: Resolve a local question using published business records and sourced local observations, with missing information and official next-action paths made explicit.

tools.name: search_business_previews
tools.description: Find public business-preview records by query and city. Catalog matches establish identity and provenance, not current suitability or availability.

tools.name: get_business_preview
tools.description: Retrieve a known business catalog record and its source or canonical preview link; does not fetch or remeasure its live website.
